name: RustGPT_Bench_100_selected
description: A focused suite of 100 selected Rust programming tasks used to evaluate model capability to write, reason about, and debug Rust code. Tasks cover API usage, common algorithms, correctness tests, and idiomatic Rust patterns to assess both functional correctness and style/robustness of generated code.
reputation: A small, targeted benchmark valued by researchers working on Rust code generation but with limited mainstream adoption compared to larger, general code benchmarks.
